sources.title: Modelling, visualization and analysis with the `grainscape` package ...
sources.snippet: The grainscape package provides functions to extract the minimum planar graph and create two types of grains of connectivity: patch and lattice forms. This reference begins by introducing these two model types, and concludes by demonstrating a variety of grainscape models, visualizations, and analyses using a consistent visual style.
